test_scope: Source-equivalent synthetic namespace/mask-selection test. Not a full Qwen, DeepSpeed, or PyTorch-2.8 runtime reproduction.
finding: The previously proposed exact-storage/view dedup is not a generally safe repair. Two distinct nn.Parameter objects can share exactly the same storage/view and are both yielded by named_parameters(remove_duplicate=True); storage-signature dedup collapses one and changes trainer semantics. A safer release-preserving filter is to construct masks only for the exact canonical names yielded by named_parameters(remove_duplicate=True) in both current and previous models. This also removes persistent-buffer mask entries that the public trainer can never consume.

Tied.interpretation: Both repairs remove the tied dead alias in this ordinary tied-Parameter case.

DistinctSameStorage.interpretation: Storage dedup is behavior-changing: p and q are different Parameter objects sharing the exact same storage/view, so the trainer consumes both. Canonical trainer-namespace filtering preserves both.

ParamBuffer.interpretation: A changed persistent floating buffer is included by the public state_dict-based builder but can never be consumed by the trainer's named_parameters loop. Canonical trainer-namespace filtering removes it.

recommended_repair_contract.rule: Load each model object, record the ordered canonical floating parameter names from model.named_parameters(remove_duplicate=True), require current/previous canonical namespaces to match (or fail closed with an explicit mismatch report), and compute/save masks only for those canonical names that also exist in both state_dicts. Do not deduplicate solely by storage pointer/view signature.
recommended_repair_contract.why: This matches the public trainer's own parameter namespace, removes tied aliases and buffers that are dead to the trainer, and preserves distinct Parameter objects even when they share storage.
recommended_repair_contract.additional_guard: Keep current/previous canonical name, shape and dtype checks explicit; if architecture/tie canonicalization changes across checkpoints, fail closed rather than silently dropping keys.

pytorch_2_8_source_support: PyTorch 2.8 Module.named_parameters defaults remove_duplicate=True; its _named_members implementation memoizes member objects, while state_dict includes parameters and persistent buffers. A faithful 2.8 executable fixture is still pending because the local runtime is 2.10.0+cpu.
